reason: The positive association holds up when I re-run it. Adding the 2020 baseline patent rate and all the other pre-period covariates, region, listed status and segment gives 0.75 (p about 0.001), against the reported 0.73. Without the 1% trim it is 0.83. The collaboration index is a post-period variable and is rightly left out. The report's 'effect' wording is causal, but the estimate does not depend on the choices I tested.
